info.text:
A deadly strike hit Riyadh's airport. Oil barely blinked.
Oct 10: a Houthi-claimed strike on Riyadh's main airport killed at least 12 and wounded 300+ (CNN, CBS, Al Jazeera).
Oct 12: Brent topped out at $105.63 overnight, less than 1% above Friday's $104.72 close. The airport strikes didn't hit oil sites, and no Saudi exports were reported lost this weekend.
Brent averaged about $114 in September 2026 vs about $71 in February (EIA).
Sources: CNN, CBS, Al Jazeera, ICE futures, EIA.
News and education, not financial advice.
